question: 查询最近24小时内出现在(118.7, 20.1)半径7公里内的船舶，再找出其中船长姓名不为空且所属公司不是‘中远海运’的MMSI。
primary_label: 题目、参考或数据口径尚不能裁定
finding: 案例108与参考使用IS NOT NULL，模型额外排空串；自然语言不为空通常可含两者，而Schema未禁止空串。缺少空值业务口径，不能直接当作推理能力问题。
next_validation: 在统一规则中区分NULL、空字符串和无效文本，先核对实际数据。

reference.question: 查询最近24小时内出现在(118.7, 20.1)半径7公里内的船舶，再找出其中船长姓名不为空且所属公司不是‘中远海运’的MMSI。
reference.query1: SELECT DISTINCT mmsi FROM vessel_ais_data WHERE timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' AND ST_DWithin(geom::geography, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(118.7, 20.1), 4326)::geography, 7000)
reference.query2: SELECT v.mmsi FROM transportation.vessel v JOIN transportation.shipping_company sc ON v.company_id = sc.company_id WHERE v.mmsi IN (result) AND v.captain_name IS NOT NULL AND sc.company_name != '中远海运'

predicted.query1: SELECT DISTINCT mmsi FROM public.vessel_ais_data WHERE timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hour' AND ST_DWithin(geom::geography, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(118.7, 20.1), 4326)::geography, 7000)
predicted.query2: SELECT v.mmsi FROM transportation.vessel v JOIN transportation.shipping_company c ON v.company_id = c.company_id WHERE v.mmsi IN (result) AND v.captain_name IS NOT NULL AND v.captain_name <> '' AND c.company_name <> '中远海运'

source_semantic_review: 预测额外要求captain_name<>空串，参考仅IS NOT NULL；可空VARCHAR未禁止空串，集合可能不同。两步空间和公司排除条件一致。
